items.desc: Matthaeus Pipelare, Missa Fors seulement, Kyrie. 5 voices (Superius, Tenor 1, Contra, Tenor 2, Bassus), each on its own staff. From the Josquin Research Project (josquin.stanford.edu, Pip1004a); encoded by Jesse Rodin. Licence: CC BY-NC 4.0; converted to Cantare notation (tools/kern2cantare.py).
